content:
Apple has launched a brand-new accessory browsing and purchasing experience on the Apple Online Store and the Apple Store app. The update makes it easier for users to browse accessories by category, view editorial picks, and more.

The changes took effect last week, and users can experience them on the Apple accessories webpage and in the Apple Store app.

The Apple accessories homepage has been completely redesigned with a more modern look. It now features the following "Editor's Picks" collections:

  • Campus Life
  • Power Accessories Picks
  • New Colors
  • Travel Essentials
  • Work From Home

These categories are expected to be updated periodically throughout the year. The page also offers recommendations based on the items currently in your shopping bag, and lets you browse accessories by product category. Users can now also chat live with Apple Specialists through the accessories website.

In addition to the new design, the revamped Apple accessories experience offers improved filtering and stronger search capabilities. Users can still easily browse accessories made by Apple and third-party manufacturers.

You can experience the new Apple accessories section on the Apple website starting today.
